#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_dir=/srv/inventory/data

    exit 1
fi

umask 077
install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "$backup_dir"
temporary=$(mktemp "$backup_dir/.inventory-data.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$temporary"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%NZ)
archive="$backup_dir/inventory-data-$stamp.tar.gz"
tar --create --gzip --file "$temporary" --directory /srv/inventory data

trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

printf 'inventory backup: created %s; retained %s archive(s)\n' "$archive" "$retained"
ANTRIEB_EOF
